rec.name: PDP Variant Cards with Unit Price, Savings Badge & Popular Variant Label

what.text: A product-page variant selector that replaces dropdowns or plain swatches with clickable cards, one per pack size. Each card shows the variant name (e.g. '1.7kg - 85m²') and its price. The final UI also shows a per-unit price (e.g. €8,81/kg) and a dark 'Spare 37%' savings strip on the larger packs. One variant can be flagged as the popular choice, which gets a coloured 'Bestseller' tag above its card. The selected card has a dark outline. On desktop at least four cards fit in one row and extra cards wrap. On mobile the cards scroll horizontally instead of wrapping.

why.text: Showing every pack size side by side with its unit price makes the volume discount visible at a glance. The savings strip is a price anchor that pushes buyers toward bigger, higher-AOV packs. The 'Bestseller' tag adds social proof and reduces choice paralysis by suggesting a default. The distinct colour makes the recommended option stand out.

how.text: Build the cards as variant blocks inside the PDP buy box in the theme editor. Flag the popular variant per product with a variant metafield ('Popular variant' = true), so the merchant picks it per product without code. The label text is editable in the section settings (default 'Bestseller') and is shown as a coloured tag on the flagged card. Size the cards so at least four fit per row on desktop. On mobile use a horizontally scrollable row with no wrapping. The savings % appears to be computed against the first variant's per-unit price (8.81→5.55 = 37%, →3.69 = 58%, →2.39 = 73%). That formula is an inference and was not confirmed in the ticket.

items: Popular variant chosen per product via the variant metafield (true)
Number of variant blocks (any number; wraps after four on desktop)
Mobile behaviour: horizontal scroll, no wrap
Custom CSS field available at section level

dependencies.text: Variant metafield 'Popular variant' (value 'true') must exist and be set on the variant. It is visible in the Shopify admin variant page under Metafields. The element was built in the 'Sectionfy' theme on the Lerava store, which is Italian-language. The savings and unit-price display needs weight or quantity data per variant (assumed). The original ticket also bundled other sections (video play button, social proof banner, testimonial videos, trust badges), which are separate elements and not covered here.

items: Share of orders by variant (larger packs vs. smallest)
Share of orders for the flagged popular variant
Mobile vs. desktop variant-selection interaction rate

images.caption: Variant cards with name and price; selected card outlined, fourth card wrapping to a second row (early state before the four-per-row fix).
Shopify admin variant page: 'Popular variant' metafield set to True marks the bestseller variant.
Theme editor and live PDP: 'Bestseller' tag on the third card, unit prices, 'Spare 37/58/73%' strips, and the 'Popular variant label' setting.
